description: Inspect a URL in Google's index. Returns indexing status, crawl info, rich results, AMP status, and mobile usability for a specific URL.

inspectionUrl.description: The fully-qualified URL to inspect (must be under the site)

languageCode.description: Optional BCP-47 language code for localized results (e.g. 'en-US', 'ko')

siteUrl.description: The site URL (property) the inspected URL belongs to

name: url_inspection_inspect
